summary.text: Todd Morgan is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 29C, which covers parts of Calvert and St. Mary's counties, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has served in the House since January 2023, after a dozen years as a St. Mary's County commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Morgan was born in Pittsburgh and graduated from Williamsville High School South in New York in 1974.
He earned a B.S. in business administration from Susquehanna University in 1978 and an M.B.A. from Marshall University in 1979.

He worked at Booz-Allen Hamilton, was a principal at Eagan, McAllister Associates from 1985 to 2003, and has been a senior program manager consultant at Science Applications International Corporation since 2003.
Morgan served as a St. Mary's County commissioner from 2010 to 2022 and was elected to the House of Delegates in November 2022.
In the House he serves on the Environment and Transportation Committee, chairs the St. Mary's House Delegation, and has been a Deputy Minority Whip in 2026.

His earlier public service includes the Historic St. Mary's City Commission from 2010 to 2020, the board of trustees of the Chesapeake Bay Trust from 2015 to 2020, and the presidency of the Southern Maryland Navy Alliance from 2004 to 2010.
